body.contents: Voidtouched weapons are an upgrade to netherite designed to make the end worth exploring, they deal 1 more damage, have the same effectiveness as efficiency 2 netherite, and come with a unique passive, Void Cull, every hit applies one stack of Void, after a short period of time these dissipate, however landing a hit restarts the timer, when a victim is struck whilst having 5 void stacks and being under 25% hp, they will take 999 damage.
